{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sienar labs''' at [[Anxarta Spaceport]] was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] that, along with the restricted [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] special projects area at the [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies Corporate Headquarters]] on Lianna, had access to a private database of Sienar Fleet Systems at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
